Join us in Sydney on November 5 for Infrastructure Finance Forum: Australia 2026, where the leading LPs, GPs, developers, sponsors and lenders shaping Australia’s infrastructure finance market come together under one roof.

 

Hear from senior industry voices as they unpack the latest market developments, the most compelling investment opportunities, and the financing trends redefining the region.

 

With more than four hours of networking, you’ll have a plethora of opportunity to connect with industry peers, rekindle existing relationships, and forge valuable new ones.

 

All attendees will also receive access to our dedicated networking app, designed to help you discover and connect with fellow participants before and during the event.

 

With just one week to go, don’t miss out. Secure your spot today!
Green Street Infrastructure subscribers have access to an exclusive 20% discount on delegate tickets. Simply enter the code Subs20%IFFAus26 at checkout to secure your subscriber rate.

20% discount available on the standard ticket rate only.
Register Now
Who Will be Attending
Join a room built for deal-making, where developers, investors and advisors come together to turn conversations into capital. See below for some of the leading organisations already confirmed to join us in Sydney.

AFM Investment Partners, AustralianSuper, Aware Super, Birdwood Energy, Brightlight, Capella Capital, Cbus, EQT, Federation Asset Management, Foresight, Future Fund, HESTA, Igneo Infrastructure Partners, John Laing, Lighthouse Infrastructure, Macquarie Group, Morrison, OMERS, Palisade Investment Partners, QIC, Sosteneo Infrastructure Partners, Stonepeak, Wollemi Capital

 

Developers
Ascera Energy, CleanPeak Energy, DCI Data Centers, GreenSquare Data Centres, Mint Renewables, NEXTDC, Pacific Partnerships, Plenary, Transgrid

 

Advisors
Corrs Chambers Westgarth, Green Street, HSBC, Mafic Partners Limited, Pitcher Partners, Rochford Group

Topics Covered Include

Financing Australia's Renewable Build Out.

PPP Is Dead.
Long Live PPP.

Alternative Assets and the Bankability Myth.

Financing Transmission: 

The Critical Enabler for Australia’s Energy Transition

Is the Project Finance Boom Around Data Centres Sustainable?

The Road to 2030: How Does Australian Infrastructure Stack Up Globally?
